mentions.name: Mojave Paint
mentions.description: A layer-based image editor for Mac, available on the Mac App Store. It handles layer operations such as blend modes with merge down, per-color-channel movement of layers, and free transform of type layers with support for oriented and axis-aligned bounding boxes.
mentions.source_excerpt: I got my app in the Mac App Store! It's a layer based image editor, which as a developer has been a nerd's paradise to develop.
